content: Distillation is carried out on Cloud TPUs in a 4x4 pod configuration (32 TPU cores overall). We optimized the loss using LAMB BIBREF39 for 250K steps, with a learning rate of 0.00125 and batch size of 4096. Depending on the student model dimension, training took between 2-4 days.
